name: epoch-ai-models
title: Epoch AI — notable AI models
description: Epoch AI's database of notable AI models: when each was published, by whom, its domain, its training compute and how that compute is known, and how the model can be reached. The file grows as models are released, and the start reads it from Epoch AI's own URL each time it is first opened, so what it draws is the file as Epoch AI publishes it that day. The Authors and Abstract columns are left out of every table the Protocol makes.

licenses.name: CC-BY-4.0
licenses.title: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, as Epoch AI publishes its data

sources.title: Epoch AI, 'Data on AI models'. Published online at epoch.ai. Retrieved from https://epoch.ai/data/ai-models

fields.name: Publication date
fields.description: When it was published or announced.

fields.name: Training compute (FLOP)
fields.description: Floating-point operations spent training it, where Epoch AI recorded or estimated them.

fields.name: Domain
fields.description: Its domains, comma-separated; the dashboard reads the first listed.

fields.name: Organization categorization
fields.description: Industry, Academia, Government or Research collective, comma-separated.

fields.name: Model accessibility
fields.description: Open weights, API or hosted access, or unreleased.

fields.name: Confidence
fields.description: Confident, Likely, Speculative or Unknown: how sure Epoch AI is of the training compute.
